subject.title: fix(plugin-sdk): remove CORS origin reflection in OAuth callbacks

question: Should the shipped plugin SDK OAuth callback default stop emitting CORS headers when callers omit corsOriginAllowlist?
rationale: That choice trades a plausible loopback CORS hardening against a public SDK compatibility path that was intentionally preserved and has shipped in v2026.6.11.

options.title: Preserve the shipped default first
options.body: Keep no-allowlist behavior compatible, then add an explicit migration/deprecation or owner-approved strict mode for fail-closed CORS.

options.title: Approve the fail-closed SDK break
options.body: Accept the compatibility break only with maintainer-visible release notes, plugin-owner migration coverage, and browser/network proof.

options.title: Pause for security design
options.body: Close or pause this narrow PR and handle loopback OAuth CORS policy in a dedicated SDK security design item.

recommendation.title: Preserve the shipped default first
recommendation.body: Keep no-allowlist behavior compatible, then add an explicit migration/deprecation or owner-approved strict mode for fail-closed CORS.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and later explicitly preserved this OAuth callback compatibility path in the merged history.
